requirement: theta_Q is a parent S^1 fibre coordinate, not a post-readout label
why_required: without this, phase is a scalar convention rather than gauge structure

requirement: Pi_Q[psi] is constructed without A_obs and without Maxwell equations
why_required: otherwise the route defines A using A

requirement: Lie_EA Pi_Q=0 for every E_A in ker(Dq_obs)
why_required: this is the direct R_A=0 input from 3781
otherwise charge-unit drift reopens R_A and dR_A

requirement: same source action owns J_Q and gives a Ward identity
why_required: needed to put EM stress into the total Hilbert source

requirement: rho=|psi| is nonzero or defects/nodes have a declared source/topological owner
why_required: phase current J/rho^2 is singular at nodes

requirement: Z_EM/N_Q/lambda_A are fixed or bounded independently of A/F readout
why_required: prevents a gauge-readout success from overclaiming alpha_EM
